scientific_role: prediction-first validation probe of a frozen affinity-map selector over an unchanged LayerCAM plus BiomedCLIP SAM proposal gallery; not a pseudo-mask consumer training run
scientific_question: Can the frozen RAD-DINO affinity-decoder map solve the proposal-selection bottleneck by selecting one variable-area raw SAM proposal from the already frozen LayerCAM plus BiomedCLIP gallery, without validation-GT input or boundary-changing post-processing?
hypothesis: Although the fixed affinity-decoder configuration failed its absolute shape gate, its affinity arm improved nominal localization ranking and saliency mass. Fixed rank supports from that map may therefore rank the existing high-oracle SAM gallery more accurately than the frozen coverage-mass selector while allowing candidate area to follow the selected proposal.

affinity_decoder_probe.retained_evidence: paired affinity-minus-nominal pixel AUROC improved overall, small and medium; pixel AP improved overall and small; saliency mass improved in every subgroup

frozen_proposal_gallery.interpretation: every frozen subgroup oracle is above the operational consumer goal; proposal availability is sufficient and selector quality is the current bottleneck

training_used_to_create_affinity_maps: pseudo evidence reconstructed only from clean-train normal RAD-DINO features
deterministic image-derived grayscale and gradient guidance
selector_inputs: frozen BiomedCLIP tiled saliency proposal source
raw SAM proposal masks and their deterministic ordering
forbidden_inputs: BTXRD train polygons, masks, boxes, points or scribbles
validation segmentation GT before prediction and candidate manifests are hash-frozen
test images, labels, predictions or metrics
weak_supervision_contract.validation_gt: may be imported only after all 371 final masks, all 184 complete candidate galleries, their manifests and prediction_freeze.json are written and hash-bound

affinity_selector_input_lock.runtime_audit: fail closed unless the mounted root contains exactly the three locked metadata files and the exact 371 manifest-indexed physical maps with matching SHA-256, schema, value range and byte total

baseline_lock.method: frozen LayerCAM plus BiomedCLIP proposal gallery using coverage_mass_sam

single_changed_mechanism.candidate_gallery: unchanged and runtime-audited against every frozen per-image component and SAM-candidate count
single_changed_mechanism.old_selector: coverage_mass_sam with up to three-candidate fusion and LayerCAM support clipping
single_changed_mechanism.support_family_interpretation: fixed top 20, 15, 10, 5, 3 and 1 percent of the frozen affinity map
selection_order: largest support Dice between raw SAM candidate and each fixed affinity support

execution_order: Verify exact source, protocol, split, checkpoints, prior-gallery artifacts, all three affinity metadata files and all 371 physical affinity-map hashes without segmentation GT
Run the four frozen focused test modules
Regenerate the unchanged LayerCAM plus BiomedCLIP SAM gallery for all 371 validation images and select exactly one raw proposal for each image-level-positive image without segmentation GT
Audit exact proposal-gallery counts and affinity-map provenance for all 371 image rows and all 184 complete candidate galleries
Freeze pseudo-mask and candidate-diagnostic manifest hashes in prediction_freeze.json
Only then load validation GT in separate evaluators
Include all complete misses and compare against the frozen same-gallery coverage-mass baseline with 10000-iteration paired complete-group bootstrap overall and for all fixed subgroups

promotion_gates.statistical_improvement: final Dice affinity selector minus frozen same-gallery coverage-mass selector has paired complete-group bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0 overall, with nonnegative mean delta in small, medium and large
promotion_gates.on_all_pass: authorize only a separate predeclared train-pseudo-mask and consumer-training protocol; do not train a consumer in this run
promotion_gates.on_fail: reject this fixed selector or retain selector research only according to the frozen gate results; do not fit rank supports, thresholds, weights, morphology or routing to the observed validation GT

relation_to_validation_goal.interpretation: passing this selector probe is necessary evidence for a separate pseudo-mask consumer experiment but does not itself satisfy the final consumer goal

forbidden: validation segmentation GT before both prediction manifests are hash-frozen
test images, labels, predictions or metrics
GT-oracle candidate selection or per-image source routing
pixelwise saliency-map blending into the final mask
candidate union or morphology that changes the selected raw SAM boundary
post-hoc support-percentile, threshold, weight, prompt, selector or morphology tuning
dropping complete misses or changing cohort, split, group IDs, subgroup definitions or Dice metric
